Class OrderTriggerEngine

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.working.OrderTriggerEngine
@Service @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="trading.order-triggers", name="enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class OrderTriggerEngine extends Object
Watches OPEN orders against the live market and fills each once the market reaches its price.

Every second - the simulator's tick - it reads all live quotes in one call and evaluates every open order (see TriggerEvaluator). Stale quotes are skipped, so an order never fills on an old price. A fill runs through OrderSubmissionService.fillOpenOrder(UUID, BigDecimal, boolean, String), the same validation, settlement and recovery path as a market order; a STOP_LIMIT whose stop is reached but whose limit isn't is only marked triggered, and keeps waiting as a limit order.

Only orders the market session allows are evaluated (SessionPolicy): outside regular hours stops don't trigger and trailing stops don't trail, and only extended-hours limit orders can fill in pre-market and after-hours.

A separate, slower schedule expires orders past their time in force.
